headline: Kraken Owner Payward to Acquire CEO's Venture Capital Firm Tribe
summary: Payward, the parent company of crypto exchange Kraken, is acquiring Tribe Capital, the venture capital business chaired by Kraken co-CEO Arjun Sethi.
why: Consolidation within cryptocurrency exchanges and their affiliated investment arms can alter governance structures and strategic direction.

impacts.name: Payward Inc.
impacts.why: Buying an affiliated venture capital firm integrates investment operations into the parent crypto exchange ecosystem.
